description.value: Toro Bar&Bar is a sushi restaurant in the heart of downtown Victoria, marketing itself as the city's best sushi destination. The restaurant offers both dine-in with reservations and online pick-up ordering with a discount. Beer, wine, and cocktails round out the Japanese-focused menu, making it a full sit-down dining option for cyclists passing through the city centre.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 79m; stands (2 spaces) at 98m; stands (2 spaces) at 98m; stands (2 spaces) at 99m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active sushi restaurant at 708 View St Victoria, BC V8W 1J8 with phone (250) 381-8868 matching the OSM record. The site advertises online pick-up ordering, dine-in reservations, and beer/wine/cocktails, confirming the business is open. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears in the website content.
concerns: OSM name is 'Toro' but the website consistently uses 'Toro Bar&Bar' (also reflected in the domain torobarbar.ca and email torobarbar@gmail.com). The OSM record likely has a truncated name.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating sushi restaurant in downtown Victoria with a live website, online ordering, and reservation system. Useful stop for touring cyclists in the city centre.

wow_evidence: online pick-up ordering with a discount...dine-in reservations
